mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.type_id, i.item_code, i.item_label, i.item_value, i.css_type, i.sort_order, i.enabled, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM app_dict_item i JOIN app_dict_type t ON t.id = i.type_id WHERE t.type_code = #{typeCode} AND t.enabled = 1 AND i.enabled = 1 ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.item_code
